blind_spots.blind_spot: Perimeter/critical-infrastructure sensor fusion depends on 5G connectivity to correlate LiDAR, thermal, and visible feeds
blind_spots.operator_reality: Remote sectors of an air base perimeter are exactly where persistent 5G coverage is least reliable; if the link drops, the Bayesian Inference Engine loses cross-sensor context and the system either goes dark or floods the operator with unfiltered single-sensor alerts
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the 5G link was likely designed for demo/pilot conditions with strong coverage, not the DDIL edges of an actual base perimeter
blind_spots.evidence_quote: coupled with Artificial Intelligence for critical infrastructure and perimeter protection...with 5G connectivity to ingest potential data from other sources

blind_spots.blind_spot: A networked, camera-and-sensor security system intended for Air Force installations never mentions ATO, RMF, STIG, or CMMC anywhere in its public language
blind_spots.operator_reality: getting a networked video/AI system onto a DoD base network requires an Authority to Operate; without a stated ATO/RMF plan the system can sit fielded-but-unaccredited indefinitely, which is the same valley-of-death failure mode as a prototype that works but never gets network access
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the team appears focused on sensor/hardware R&D (Bayesian fusion, IP67/68 hardening) rather than the compliance path onto government networks
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Deployment of this technology at air bases will dramatically enhance security forces ability to rapidly respond to threats in real-time and maintain situational awareness and operational integrity 24/7/365

blind_spots.blind_spot: Sustainment and field-maintenance model for a multi-sensor edge device is described only as generic 'support services,' not a real field logistics plan
blind_spots.operator_reality: an E-5 running base perimeter security will not call an engineer when a LiDAR module or radiation sensor fails at 0300 — the device needs field-swappable spares, a trained on-base maintainer, and a documented failure mode; 'implementation, direct training, installation and commissioning' does not describe that
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: the company's language centers on product capability and manufacturing quality (IP67/68, UL/DLC certs), not on the operational sustainment burden after handoff
blind_spots.evidence_quote: we provide Grade A support services that include Engineering, implementation, direct training, installation and commissioning for our customers

opener_hook: Your 2022 Air Force Phase II proposed 5G connectivity to fuse LiDAR, thermal, and visible sensor data for air-base perimeter protection — worth a look at what happens to that fusion pipeline when the link drops mid-perimeter.
what_they_do: Small manufacturer of ruggedized multi-sensor edge security devices (LiDAR, radiation detection, cameras, AI fusion) built into LED street-lighting hardware, sold to security/government customers alongside a commercial solar/LED lighting line.
